parallel.requirements: Recognized the benchmark as behavioral reverse engineering of hashcards with no source lookup, no binary analysis, and a required original replacement executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Explored docs and CLI locally, then delegated thirteen behavioral research areas through a workflow while the parent kept hash investigation on the critical path.
parallel.implementation: Performed many probes and wrote temporary hash brute-force helpers in scratch space, but did not produce the required replacement codebase or executable.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No child findings were integrated into a submitted implementation; artifact validation shows the original tree and artifact_ok false.
parallel.verification: Used behavioral probes against the original binary, but no final replacement build or whole-task verification occurred before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Workflow state ended killed with null result, the agent timed out, and the official evaluator completed with compile_failed and no tests run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same reverse-engineering and no-wrapper constraints from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept exploration, hash investigation, and potential implementation in one agent because workflows and delegation tools were disabled.
serial.implementation: Explored CLI/export/check/drill behavior and pursued hash construction locally, but did not create a final replacement codebase or executable.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No assembled implementation was delivered; artifact validation shows the same original tree and artifact_ok false.
serial.verification: Verified observations against the original binary only; there was no replacement build or acceptance run before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also timed out and the official evaluator completed with compile_failed and no tests run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized that the task required behavioral reverse engineering of hashcards and an original replacement executable, not wrapping the provided binary.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had the same prompt and recognized the same reverse-engineering and no-wrapper constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is evidenced; both runs worked from the same task obligations and both ultimately failed to deliver the executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run decomposed the behavioral surface into thirteen workflow areas and launched them as child agents while the parent continued the hash path.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had workflows disabled, zero subagents, and kept exploration and implementation attempts in one local trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel converted the task into broad concurrent research plus a parent critical path; serial stayed single-owner and single-threaded.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel child briefs shared common behavioral-observation rules and separate scratch/output locations, but they were research briefs rather than implementation interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had no child interfaces or handoffs; context stayed in the single agent's local exploration.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete difference is breadth of delegated research, not an omitted child requirement or incompatible cross-agent implementation contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After probing behavior, the parallel parent focused late effort on brute-forcing hash construction and wrote a temporary C brute-force program rather than a replacement codebase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run similarly spent substantial local effort on hash/brute-force investigation and did not create a final replacement codebase.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implementation paths stalled on reverse-engineering rather than delivery; parallel added concurrent behavioral coverage but did not convert it into implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel workflow was still in progress with stalled retries and was killed with a null aggregate result, so no child result lifecycle reached a usable parent integration point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had no workflow result lifecycle because delegation tools were disabled and no child logs existed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed workflow lifecycle; serial avoided that class of lifecycle entirely but still failed by not finishing the local implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The artifact validation packed the original workspace tree and marked the artifact not OK; there is no evidence of integrated replacement source in the delivered artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial artifact validation likewise packed the original workspace tree and marked the artifact not OK.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concrete shared-state race distinguishes the runs; both failed to integrate and deliver a new implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The completed official evaluator reported compile_failed and 1293 tests not run for the parallel artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The completed official evaluator reported the same compile_failed condition and 1293 tests not run for the serial artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no evaluator outcome differential; both artifacts were uncompilable or not buildable by the official harness.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run used 32 subagents, over 1.19M workflow-child tokens, 576 child-tool calls, and timed out after the agent process returned 143.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also timed out, but with zero subagents and no workflow-child tokens or workflow tasks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent a large share of budget on breadth and retries; serial spent its whole budget locally. Both closed with no deliverable, so this is adverse but not outcome-differential.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluation is not discordant: both modes failed with compile_failed and 1293 tests not run. The material task-solving difference is that parallel used a broad child-agent workflow for behavioral coverage while serial stayed local; neither converted the learned behavior into a delivered replacement executable.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out and stalled retries consumed parallel budget while the parent stayed on hash investigation.
No child aggregate result or replacement implementation was integrated before timeout.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all work in one local trajectory with delegation disabled.
Serial still did not finish or deliver a compileable replacement implementation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both runs appear blocked by incomplete reverse engineering and implementation, especially around hash behavior and delivery.
Both final artifacts lacked a buildable replacement executable, producing compile_failed rather than partial test failures.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained parallel pattern is adverse process evidence only

The parallel parent deliberately launched a thirteen-area research workflow and each area was executed with agent calls. The workflow journal and state show many child starts, stalled retries, null workflow result, killed status, and over one million child tokens. The parent continued local hash brute-force work while the broad workflow ran, but the run reached the process timeout and official evaluation with no replacement implementation or compileable deliverable. The serial control explored many of the same surfaces locally without child agents, so the concrete parallel-specific adverse episode is budget exhaustion from fan-out breadth and retries rather than ordinary task difficulty.
candidates.realized_consequence: The broad workflow and retry fan-out consumed the finite run window before the parent produced, assembled, or packaged a replacement executable, leaving the official artifact as the original tree and the evaluator at compile_failed.
candidates.near_match_reason: Critical-Path Starvation is a close description of displaced implementation work, but the direct observed boundary is collective workflow breadth and retries consuming the budget.
